Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

You hate the taste of blood. Your body craves it, but you think it tastes disgusting, going out of your way to feed on drunks since the alcohol helps kill the taste. The Vaulderie is torture for you.

Trigger/Effect: You must win or tie a Static Test each time you participate in the Vaulderie to see if you spit out the blood. If you fail, you must burn a Willpower Trait if you wish to keep it down.
